outcome: population coverage for services (childhood immunisation, Caesarean births, antenatal services, birthing care)
cohort: The study analyzed routine health management information systems data from health facilities serving population subgroups in the Volta Region, Ghana.
finding: Primary health care has grown substantially in the study area compared to emergency obstetric care.
mod_finding: Caesarean births had the lowest geographic coverage within 30 minutes of the nearest health facility (maximum 75.2%) between 2016 and 2022.
